description: Lists locked calls from the Capital Signal calls ledger: each with tickers, direction, horizon, thesis, evidence doc_keys, base rate, sha256 and canonical JSON (sha256 of canonical = the hash; verify against /calls.txt), and, once its horizon has passed, its score (return, benchmark return, signed excess, hit). status: open | scored | all; author: 'me' for the caller's own calls or an author id from a previous result; since: YYYY-MM-DD. Free.

author.description: 'me', or an author id such as 'u_1a2b3c4d5e' or 'u_1a2b3c4d5e/newsletter'.

cursor.description: Next page: the nextCursor from the previous response. A non-null nextCursor means more calls follow; null is the last page.

limit.description: Max calls (default 25, max 200; pages are kept under 30,000 characters).

since.description: Calls locked on or after YYYY-MM-DD.

name: calls
title: Calls
